assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One complete freestanding module centered on a neutral warm-grey seamless background, no surrounding world, no clouds, no landscape, no people, no mascot, no text, no watermark. Orthographic-like three-quarter view with minimal perspective distortion, full silhouette visible with generous margin, soft directional studio light. Module is intended to be reconstructed in Blender with precise modular dimensions, so emphasize clear buildable silhouette and material separation, no impossible delicate floating fragments. Two very thin champagne-gold rings delimit shaft ends. One small oval emerald stone jewel set into the capital. Marble predominates, refined stately proportions, clear underside and top mounting faces. Warm grey natural thin marble veins at real architectural scale. No statue on top.
